title: Observability Telemetry and Distributed Tracing Layer
summary: Produce safe correlated metrics, logs and traces linked to governed evidence without replacing authoritative engineering truth.

intent.statement: Explain platform behaviour through safe causal telemetry across synchronous and asynchronous boundaries while preserving tenant, classification and evidence controls.
desired_outcomes: Every critical platform boundary emits correlation context.
Telemetry is safe, bounded, classified and access-controlled.
SLO and alert signals link to operational evidence, not unverified claims.

success_measures.name: Trace continuity
success_measures.target: 100% critical async handoff fixtures retain or link causal context

success_measures.name: Telemetry sanitisation
success_measures.target: 0 prohibited secret/private-reasoning fields persisted in test telemetry

problem.statement: Without unified safe telemetry, platform operators cannot trace failures across gateway, queues, workers, agents, tools and streaming, while uncontrolled logging risks sensitive-data leakage.
problem.current_state: AGASTYA has Ledger evidence and runtime contracts but no common signal/context/SLO/sanitisation standard.
impact: Errors may lack governed resource/evidence linkage.
Raw telemetry can leak secrets or create uncontrolled cost/cardinality.

business_context.business_value: Safe causal telemetry accelerates incident investigation and SLO management while preserving AGASTYA's evidence and data-protection model.

actors.name: Instrumented Platform Component
goals: Emit safe telemetry context and signals.

actors.name: Telemetry Collector
goals: Validate, sanitise, sample and route telemetry.

functional_requirements.title: Define canonical context
functional_requirements.statement: The system shall define a versioned telemetry context including trace/span, correlation/request, tenant/project, operation/task, retry and safe source/evidence references.

functional_requirements.title: Propagate async context
functional_requirements.statement: The system shall propagate or causally link context across API, queue, worker, outbox, agent, tool, Vault, extension and streaming boundaries.

functional_requirements.title: Collect safe signals
functional_requirements.statement: The system shall collect schema-valid metrics, structured logs and traces with allowlisted attributes, classification, payload limits and redaction before persistence/export.

functional_requirements.title: Define SLO and sampling controls
functional_requirements.statement: The system shall calculate SLI/SLO measures and apply documented sampling, retention, aggregation, quota and cardinality controls while preserving mandatory error/security/decision signals.

functional_requirements.title: Govern telemetry exploration and alerts
functional_requirements.statement: The system shall provide classification-filtered telemetry exploration and correlated alert/incident signals with safe evidence links and no automatic remediation.

non_functional_requirements.statement: Collectors shall reject/redact secret, private reasoning, raw credential, prohibited header/body and oversized telemetry before storage or export.
non_functional_requirements.verification_method: Collector security suite submits prohibited attributes and inspects stored/exported fixtures.
non_functional_requirements.target: Zero prohibited raw fields in telemetry fixtures.

provenance.rationale: Telemetry must not widen data leakage.

non_functional_requirements.statement: Telemetry collection shall apply sampling/cardinality/buffer controls so instrumentation cannot exhaust application or collector resources.
non_functional_requirements.verification_method: Load fixtures assert bounded metric labels, queue/buffer and sampling outcomes.
non_functional_requirements.target: No uncontrolled high-cardinality or unbounded telemetry buffer in performance suite.

business_rules.statement: Telemetry attributes are allowlisted, classified and bounded; raw secret values, private reasoning, credentials and unbounded request payloads are prohibited.
Telemetry links to authoritative resources/evidence through safe references and cannot independently change verification, approval or engineering truth state.

constraints.statement: Initial observability excludes raw payload/prompt capture, external export, vendor deployment, alert routing and automatic remediation.
constraints.rationale: Collection, retention, access and incident contracts must be approved first.

dependencies.name: Telemetry collector and storage architecture
dependencies.risk: Collector/storage, data residency, retention and query controls require ADR.

bounded_contexts.name: Platform Observability
bounded_contexts.responsibility: Own telemetry context, signal contracts, sanitisation, sampling, SLO and alert evidence.

ubiquitous_language.definition: Versioned safe causal metadata propagated across platform boundaries.
Defined measurable service behaviour used to calculate objective.
Rejecting or redacting telemetry that violates schema/classification policy.

workflows.name: Trace asynchronous platform operation

steps.action: Creates correlation/trace context at request boundary.
steps.result: Safe context links operation and source references.

steps.action: Propagates/links context through queue, worker and tool attempts.
Sanitises/samples/classifies signals and links safe evidence reference.
steps.result: Operational data is safe and non-authoritative.

outcomes: Operators can investigate causal path without exposing secrets or altering truth.
workflows.error_handling: Collector rejects prohibited data and records safe sanitisation outcome.

states.name: QUARANTINED
states.description: Unsafe signal withheld with safe evidence.

security_requirements.statement: Telemetry ingestion and query shall enforce classification, tenant/project scope, attribute allowlist and safe reference-only evidence linkage.
security_requirements.verification_method: Security tests cover prohibited attributes, cross-project query and evidence truth confusion.

observability_requirements.statement: Collector health, sanitisation, sampling, SLO evaluation and alert lifecycle shall emit safe correlated operational evidence.
observability_requirements.verification_method: Reconstruct SLO breach and sanitisation event through telemetry/evidence references.

acceptance_criteria.title: Async trace context is linked
acceptance_criteria.given: Gateway request launches worker agent tool work.
acceptance_criteria.then: Trace/correlation links gateway, queue, attempt, tool and safe evidence references.

acceptance_criteria.title: Unsafe telemetry is sanitised
acceptance_criteria.given: Record contains prohibited or oversized attribute.
acceptance_criteria.then: Material is rejected/redacted before storage/export and safe sanitisation evidence exists.

acceptance_criteria.title: Sampling is bounded
acceptance_criteria.then: Metrics remain bounded and mandatory error/security/decision signals remain available.

acceptance_criteria.title: Telemetry query respects scope
acceptance_criteria.given: Authorised and unauthorised users query project telemetry.
acceptance_criteria.then: Allowed data is filtered and cross-project data is denied.

acceptance_criteria.title: SLO breach generates safe incident
acceptance_criteria.then: Correlated alert/incident signal has safe runbook/evidence references and no automatic remediation.

acceptance_criteria.title: Operational observation is not verification truth
acceptance_criteria.then: View distinguishes telemetry observation from authoritative verification result.

test_requirements.scope: Allowlist, redaction, classification and payload-limit collector suite.
test_requirements.expected_evidence: Quarantined/sanitised fixtures with no unsafe data.

test_requirements.scope: Sampling, cardinality and buffer policy under load.
Telemetry query access and evidence-truth distinction.
test_requirements.expected_evidence: Scoped query and UI/API contract report.

test_requirements.scope: SLI/SLO evaluation and alert evidence generation.

risks.title: Telemetry leakage or cardinality/cost exhaustion
risks.description: Unsafe attributes or uncontrolled signal volume can expose data and destabilise cost/performance.
risks.mitigation: Allowlist/redaction, classification, sampling, quotas, access policy and collector ADR.

open_questions.question: Which telemetry collector, storage and visualisation architecture meets residency, retention and query requirements?
open_questions.resolution: Accepted as a detailed-design risk. Collector, storage and visualisation ADR is mandatory before implementation.

open_questions.question: What telemetry retention, export and access policy applies per tenant/project/classification?
open_questions.impact_if_unresolved: Safe storage and query policy cannot be finalised.
open_questions.resolution: Accepted as a detailed-design risk. Classification, retention, export and access policy is mandatory before collection deployment.

architecture_decisions.title: Use safe correlated metrics logs and traces linked to evidence
architecture_decisions.context: AGASTYA needs investigation and SLO insight across distributed/asynchronous work without making telemetry an uncontrolled data store or source of truth.
architecture_decisions.decision: Adopt versioned telemetry context, attribute allowlists, classification/redaction, async causal links, sampling/SLO controls and safe references to Ledger/resources.

alternatives.name: Unstructured application logs
alternatives.summary: Treat text logs as the primary observability mechanism.
alternatives.rejection_reason: Cannot safely enforce schema, correlation, classification, cardinality or reliable SLO analysis.

architecture_decisions.rationale: Structured safe telemetry enables operations while preserving evidence and security boundaries.
consequences: Collector/storage ADR and retention policy are mandatory.
Every runtime boundary needs instrumentation contract.

provenance.rationale: Telemetry must link operational signals to safe authoritative evidence references.

coverage_summary.method: Initial observability draft mapping; implementation coverage is not yet applicable.
